name: oracle-twap
description: Uniswap V3 TWAP oracle with 30-minute interval — resistant to flash loan manipulation
why_safe: The oracle queries `observe` with a 30-minute interval (1800 seconds). Flash loan manipulation requires altering the spot price within a single block, which has a negligible effect on a 30-minute TWAP.

expected_verdict.reason: TWAP interval is sufficiently long (30 minutes) to prevent flash loan manipulation. Negative memory pattern FP-SEED-003 applies.
